sections.heading: Executive Summary
paragraphs: Pilot a self-service password reset (SSPR) tool for 500 staff in Finance and Marketing to cut password-related service desk tickets by 60%, reduce resolution time from 15 min to <2 min, and improve satisfaction.

sections.heading: Objectives & Scope
bullets: Enable secure self-service resets without service desk
Target: ≥60% ticket reduction, 90% adoption in 4 weeks
Scope: 500 staff, 4-week pilot from 2026-11-18, excludes privileged accounts

sections.heading: Benefits & Budget
bullets: ~120 hrs/month saved in service desk effort
Pilot cost: ZAR 45,000 (3-month licence) + 40 hrs IT time; full rollout est. ZAR 320k/yr for 5,000 users

sections.heading: Risks & Approval
bullets: Low adoption – targeted comms, manager endorsement
paragraphs: Request approval to proceed from 2026-11-18 and ZAR 45,000 from IT innovation budget. Go/no-go for full rollout by 2026-12-22.

subtitle: Reduce IT support load and improve user experience
title: Pilot Proposal: Self-Service Password Reset Tool for 500 Staff
